reference_note: Visual style rewritten to prioritize readable, expressive anthropomorphic bread characters over cinematic-silhouette abstraction, per user reference image (8-panel bread boxing comic). Updated again to finalize the 7-line censored trash-talk/punch voice flow and matching caption cues; visual_prompt fields are unchanged from the prior version since this update is audio/caption-only.
caption_style: Bold white text, thick black outline/drop shadow, centered near screen middle (not bottom-corner small subtitles), TikTok/Reels viral caption style, max 3-5 words per line, high contrast, readable on phone, punch-moment captions rendered larger/stronger, final question rendered large and clear. Censored swears are always rendered censored in caption text (f***, b****), never spelled out in full.
voice_style: Tiny in-character bread-boxer voices, dirty/hoarse/funny adult-animation energy per the locked B-Cartoon post-process chain (see scripts/postprocess_voice_022.py FINAL_VARIANT): wheat_bread loud/shrill/aggressive, dark_rye quiet/deadpan/cold, referee_crumb fast/cracked/panicked, crowd_crumbs chaotic multi-layer burst. Lines short, dirty-but-intelligible. Overall dialogue/SFX mix louder and more present than prior videos, audible on phone speakers, but never clipping (alimiter on every chain). No real human, celebrity, or copyrighted/impersonated voice. ElevenLabs approved for raw lines (see VOICE_PRESETS); actual --live generation for this finalized 7-line flow has not been run yet and requires explicit approval.
